description: Hi this side Noorulain Hameed from Mastung, Balochistan! I am SoloFrontier, solo team for Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data. My area grows apples, grapes, wheat but rains are late and water is less. I want to use NASA GPM, SMAP, POWER data to show how our season shifted and help local farmers adapt. Skills: local agri knowledge, research, storytelling. Focus: Mastung.
